row_notes.pcb_pcba: qty2 = (JLC fees $59.50 + parts 2x$9.77)/2 from project cost doc; LCSC breaks for ESP32-S3-MINI-1-N4R2 ($5.00/$4.50/$3.63/$3.38) and TCA8418 ($1.12/$0.92/$0.69/$0.61) checked 2026-10-03; other rows estimate
row_notes.camera_ov5640af: qty2-10 Seeed OV5640 AF (~GBP11 UK, US est); 50+ generic 24-pin DVP AF module $4.58-$8 listings; volume estimate
row_notes.epaper_2in13: Waveshare raw 2.13in $6.31-$6.99 (waveshare.com, 2026-10-03); 100+ Good Display GDEY0213B74 direct, estimate
row_notes.battery_100mAh: Adafruit #1570 $5.95 (2026-10-03); 10/100 tiers assume Adafruit's usual 10%/20% breaks (estimate); 500+ custom cell with UN38.3 from Shenzhen, Alibaba range $0.61-$1.70 + pack/PCM (estimate)
row_notes.magnetic_connector_pair: Adafruit #5358 $6.50/$5.85/$5.20 (1/10/100+); 500+ OEM pogo-magnet pair, pins ~$0.23-0.25 @MOQ1000 (estimate for full pair)
row_notes.enclosure_and_keypad: 2-50: donor Casio fx-115ES ~$20 (Walmart $19.99, 2026-10-03); 100: 3D-printed shell + small-batch silicone keypad incl. tooling share (estimate); 500-1000: printed/urethane-cast (estimate); 5000+: injection mold, ~$25k tooling amortized + ~$1.50/set (estimate)
row_notes.freight_and_import_duty: qty2 = DHL + JLC DDP tariff share (JLC FAQ: 35-92.5% total tariff on China goods) estimate; volume = ~35% duty on China-made content + sea/air freight, estimate
row_notes.certification_amortized: ~$3.5k one-time (FCC Part 15B SDoC $1-2.5k, lawyer, misc) spread over the batch; only counted once you sell (qty 100+). estimate

enclosure_options_per_unit.note: estimates; injection = $25,000 tooling / qty + $1.50 per set. Break-even vs ~$9 printed/cast is ~3,300 units
